notes.title: CELEBRATING A DECADE OF SPEED IN SEASON 3
notes.content:
[p]2025 sees Haas F1 Team racing a landmark 10th consecutive season and we’re marking the occasion by dedicating Season 3 of F1® 25’s live service to them. That’s not all, we’ve also added F2™ 2025, made a second Driver Ratings update, and refreshed the look of each of the 10 F1® teams.

Get involved by loading up F1® 25 between September 17 and November 11.
  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/bdea2b82227509c3af5a051396956d95f9f96907.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]SEASON 3: A DECADE OF SPEED[/b][/h1][p]From the inclusion of the next generation of talent with the F2™ 2025 roster, to a pair of throwbacks to key moments in Haas’ ten-year history, there’s plenty to look forward to in Season 3. 

To read the detailed Patch Notes, including details on how computer-controlled (AI) drivers have been improved with this update, head to the separate post [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3059520/announcements/detail/503962044337225832?snr=2___"]linked here[/url].
[/p][h2]Scenario Event: 2018 Austrian Grand Prix Challenge (Sep 17 - Oct 1)[/h2][p]In the first event to celebrate Haas F1 Team’s 10th anniversary in Formula 1®, you’ll be tasked with an objective inspired by the team’s best ever result - 4th & 5th at 2018’s Austrian Grand Prix - with a modern grid.

Back then, a mega Qualifying on the Saturday saw Romain Grosjean finding himself on the third row of the grid starting in 6th, with teammate Kevin Magnussen just behind him in 8th. For this F1® 25 recreation though, your slightly tougher challenge is to take Oliver Bearman from 9th all the way to 4th. 

Hit the target and not only will you unlock a new special edition livery to add to your collection in that of the [b]Haas 2025 Canada livery[/b] but you’ll also earn yourself [b]Oliver Bearman’s Silverstone and Monaco Grand Prix helmets[/b] too.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/e97a10e06f5fd87376bc100ba1843faf4536047b.jpg"][/img]Don’t forget, special edition liveries work a little differently this year. Instead of the livery applying to the F1® World car, it’s now applied to the team it represents, letting you choose which livery to use every time you race as that team. Once you’ve got it, it’s yours to keep. 

To take part in this challenge, head to F1® World and navigate to Play > Solo & Multiplayer Events.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/673c67e53f1083741d17595ca7590019975a6934.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Scenario Event: Australia 2016 Race Replay (Oct 1 - Oct 15)[/h2][p]The second Haas celebration event takes you back to where it all began, the 2016 Australian Grand Prix - Haas F1 Team’s first entry into the sport.  

In what was a mixed result for each side of the Haas garage, coming away with points in their debut race was a remarkable achievement, as Grosjean ascended from a Qualifying position of 19th to take the chequered flag in 6th. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/25bd521d7657e7ba7a62ce37d648d6286bc8366a.jpg"][/img]With a modern car, can you take Esteban Ocon from 10th to a podium? Do so and you’ll unlock Haas’ eye-catching [b]2025 Suzuka livery[/b], [b]Esteban’s accompanying race helmet, and the one he used at Miami. 

[/b]Once unlocked, the livery can be selected when racing as Haas, with the helmets added to your inventory, equippable to your custom driver.  [/p][h2]One More Event: Details to Follow[/h2][p]The third and final Haas celebration event is one you don’t want to miss. We’ll share more in the coming weeks, so be sure to [url="https://linktr.ee/easportsf1"][u]follow our socials[/u][/url] for more info. 
[/p][h2]New Content: F2™ 2025[/h2][p]Introducing the stars of the future, the 2025 roster of Formula 2™ teams and drivers have been added to the game, reflecting those racing in the real-world season. 

With three events left, Invicta Racing’s Leonardo Fornaroli is leading the Championship, aiming for unprecedented back-to-back titles after winning in Formula 3™ last year. It’s far from over though, as Luke Browning’s numerous visits to the podium has kept him in the fight, taking his first Feature Race win last time out in Monza. With just 50 points separating Leonardo in first and Alex Dunne in fifth, there’s plenty to play for.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/675e70a6c1c3a77a7e0b85d4d2698f3af70baed8.jpg"][/img]You’ll have to pick which of the 22 drivers and 11 teams to represent before recreating your choice of the full 14-location F2™ 2025 championship, incorporating Sprint and Feature races, or a Custom Championship. With 27 variations of 24 circuits at your disposal, you could choose to race up to 54 times, with circuits not typically used to having Formula 2™ cars hurtling around them. 

Scroll to the right of the F1® World > Play screen to get started with these V6 turbo-charged machines. This is where you can also hone your skills in Time Trial, or take the race online in Multiplayer events.

If you’ve got a copy of F1® 25, enjoy F2™ 2025 at no extra cost once you’ve updated your game.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Content: ‘Sports Update’[/h2][p]Throughout the season, F1® teams routinely tweak their cars to remain competitive with the rest of the field. As the saying goes: “If you’re not moving forward, you’re moving backwards”.

Season 3 aims to bring each of the 10 teams’ cars closer to their real-world counterparts based on some of these subtle changes, ranging from updated front wing shapes and side pods, to the addition of new team sponsors.

With focus shifting to the regulation changes coming in 2026, there have been fewer changes made. As such, this year’s ‘Sports Update’ is more subtle than in previous years but every team has had at least one adjustment.
[/p][h3]Alpine[/h3][list][*][p]New front wing shape[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to sponsor positions on the vehicle livery and pit crew clothing[/p][/*][*][p]Pierre Gasly - Updates to helmet sponsor positions[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Aston Martin[/h3][list][*][p]Updates to the car’s nose, suspension arm, engine cover, side pod, barge board and rear wing[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to sponsor positions on the vehicle livery and driver race suits[/p][/*][*][p]“Fico” sponsor removed from gloves[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/73173a9c3ccddcd3d684271f52641332383d91c7.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Scuderia Ferrari[/h3][list][*][p]Updates to the car’s front wing, engine cover, and wheel arches[/p][/*][*][p]Updated “UniCredit” positions on livery[/p][/*][*][p]Lewis Hamilton - “Perplexity” sponsor added to race helmet[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/8de174352f5df1df8b1e7faf1dbefdc69c83bf96.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Haas[/h3][list][*][p]“Infobip” sponsor added to the vehicle livery[/p][/*][*][p]Oliver Bearman - “Aventum” sponsor added to race suit[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]McLaren[/h3][list][*][p]Updates to the car’s front wing, engine cover, and rear wing[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to sponsor positions on the vehicle livery[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Mercedes[/h3][list][*][p]Updates to the car’s nose shape[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/3d2aa39c9caa85b815a00178b720a25142dabb0f.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Racing Bulls[/h3][list][*][p]Updates to the car’s front wing and side pod[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to sponsor positions on the vehicle livery and driver race suits[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Red Bull[/h3][list][*][p]Updates to the car’s nose, front wing, engine intake, wing mirrors, and rear wing [/p][/*][*][p]“Gate” sponsor logo updated on the vehicle livery and team clothing[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/b07f34cd804c2d1c0c7cc3d130257f7e7374f9ae.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Sauber[/h3][list][*][p]Updates to sponsor positions on the vehicle livery[/p][/*][*][p]“Zero” sponsor removed from the driver race suits[/p][/*][*][p]Nico Hülkenberg - “Claro” and “PicPay” sponsors added to race helmet[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Williams[/h3][list][*][p]Updates to the car’s front wing shape[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to sponsor positions on the vehicle livery[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These changes will be applied automatically once you update your copy of F1® 25.[/p][p][/p][h2]Driver Ratings Update: Belgium to Italy (Monza)[/h2][p]We’ve been treated to a pretty unpredictable season thus far, with surprises up and down the grid. Whilst the Constructors’ title is looking like it’ll be wrapped up soon, the story of the Drivers’ title will no doubt keep twisting and turning into the last few races.

Analysing the latest batch of real-world results, from Belgium to Italy in Monza, we’re updating each of the Driver Ratings accordingly, [b]available to apply to existing saves from 10am UTC on September 18.

[/b]To learn more about Driver Ratings and how they’re calculated, you can take a look at [url="https://www.ea.com/games/f1/f1-25/news/f1-25-driver-ratings"][u]this article[/u][/url]. Here are some of the headline changes:[/p][p][/p][h3]Max Verstappen - Champion Results[/h3][p]Verstappen’s dominance the last few seasons has been the stuff of dreams for the Dutchman and whilst the first half of the 2025 season wouldn’t have been up to his high standards, he and his team have kept their heads down and eked out some remarkable performances that have emphasised his Champion mentality.

Whilst trailing both McLaren’s in the Drivers’ Championship by 63 and 94 points respectively, could his flawless victory in Monza be the start of a monumental comeback?

Max’s [b]Overall [/b]rating has risen to 94, thanks to an [b]Awareness [/b]boost of three and a single point [b]Racecraft [/b]increase.[/p][h3]Carlos Sainz - Tough Mistakes[/h3][p]Sainz’s F1® 25 Overall rating started as high as 90 when the game was released but following our first Ratings update and now this most recent one, he’s closer to the 80 mark. 

Collisions with Gasly, Bearman, and Lawson, the latter resulting in a 10-second penalty, haven’t helped but hopefully his fortunes can turn around for the remaining few races. 

Drops in [b]Racecraft [/b](-3), [b]Awareness [/b](-4), and [b]Pace [/b](-1) have all played their part in contributing to Carlos’ [b]Overall [/b]rating dipping to 84.[/p][p][/p][h3]Gabriel Bortoleto - Remarkable Consistency[/h3][p]Despite his championship winning season in F2™, Bortoleto may not have gambled on too much success given Sauber’s 10th place finish in 2024. Yet, his consistency over the last few races has been stand-out, with three out of four points-scoring finishes. This contribution has helped fuel the team’s resurgence, now just a dozen points off 5th place in the Constructors’. 

With Ratings boosts in every stat - [b]Experience [/b](+3), [b]Racecraft [/b](+3), [b]Awareness [/b](+1), and [b]Pace [/b](+6) - Gabriel sees his [b]Overall [/b]rating climb four points to 78.[/p][p][/p][h3]Fernando Alonso - Legend Finds Form[/h3][p]The seemingly timeless Fernando Alonso has tackled a challenging season start at Aston Martin, with zero Championship points to speak of going into Spain. However, a flurry of points-scoring finishes including a 5th place in Hungary have got him off the mark in 2025. Whilst reliability issues forced him to retire in Monza, there’s no doubting his everlasting talent. 

Despite a single point drop for [b]Racecraft[/b],[b] [/b]Fernando has seen his [b]Overall [/b]rating rise to 89 following improvements in [b]Awareness [/b](+1) and [b]Pace [/b](+2).

With Ratings boosts for rookies [b]Isack Hadjar[/b], [b]Liam Lawson[/b], and [b]Oliver Bearman[/b] be sure to [url="https://www.ea.com/games/f1/ratings"][u]check out the full Driver Ratings breakdown here[/u][/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Special Event: Free Play Weekend (Oct 16 - Oct 20)[/h2][p]To coincide with the United States Grand Prix, we’re giving those of you who are yet to play F1® 25 a chance to check out the full game for free all race weekend on Steam. 

From the story-driven action in Braking Point, to the newly-revamped My Team mode, and everything in between, experience the action and carry over your progress to the full game if you choose to purchase. 

For those of you who have the game already, we’re running a [b]Double XP weekend[/b] to speed up your progress through the game’s Podium Pass.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/bad5991fc4bd9a00d48f893f8eb1a6b5daad42af.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Podium Pass: Season Three (Sep 17 - Nov 12)[/h2][p]Whether it’s progressing through My Team, sailing through the ranks in Multiplayer, or refining your skills in Time Trial, you’ll earn XP towards the refreshed 50 levels of Podium Pass in F1® 25, with rewards aplenty in both the Free and VIP tiers.

Amongst the Free tier rewards, you’ll find a full [b]Transmitter livery set [/b](vehicle livery, race suit, gloves) and 2,500 PitCoin, whereas the VIP rewards include the [b]Monnaie Paris 2 sponsor livery set, [/b]and 6,500 PitCoin.

Track your progress through the Podium Pass by opening the Player Hub from the Main Menu and be sure not to let those PitCoin go to waste by visiting the Podium Pass Store from time to time.

Yet to get involved in the action? [url="https://www.ea.com/games/f1/f1-25/buy"][u]Pick up F1® 25 today[/u][/url] to take center stage in your very own F1® blockbuster. 

Don’t forget to [url="https://linktr.ee/easportsf1"][u]follow @easportsf1 across social media[/u][/url] for all the latest updates.

- James / CM_TGK
Social, Community, and Creator Manager @ EA SPORTS / Codemasters[/p]

notes.title: v1.12 (Season 3) - PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
[p]To coincide with Season 3 going live on September 17, the latest title update will be made available for F1® 25, adding a handful of new and exciting features as well as an improvement to computer-controlled (AI) drivers in all weather conditions.

Patch v1.12 will begin rolling out at 10am UTC on Monday, September 15. Please ensure your PC or console is connected to the internet in order to receive the update. 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/5faba1abe877abbf73b033a5cd6d346d5b18d4a3.jpg"][/img][/p][h1][b]New Features and Season 3 Content[/b][/h1][p][/p][h2]Available Sep 15[/h2][list][*][p]Addition of F2™ 2025 including all cars, teams, and drivers[/p][/*][*][p]‘Sports Update’ for F1® 2025 cars, teams, and drivers featuring a number of visual updates and sponsor changes[/p][/*][*][p]‘Computer-Controlled Drivers (AI) Update’ and all other bug fixes mentioned below[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Available Sep 17[/h2][list][*][p]Season 3 updates, including refreshed Podium Pass tiers and Podium Pass Store items[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Available Sep 18[/h2][list][*][p]Second Driver Ratings update based real-world results from Belgium to Italy (Monza)[/p][/*][/list][p]To read more about the new features coming alongside this patch and what to expect in Season 3, head to our dedicated blog post on Wednesday.
[/p][h1][b]v1.12 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][h1]Computer-Controlled Drivers (AI) Update[/h1][list][*][p]AI behaviour has been updated so that they can brake later into and accelerate less effectively out of turns. In Dry conditions this will not affect overall lap time, but in the Wet they will be slightly slower[/p][/*][/list][p][i]Following extensive internal testing and feedback from the broad F1 25 community, this change refines and retunes some of the fundamental racing characteristics of computer-controlled drivers (AI).  

You will now notice that AI race in a more flowing fashion, ensuring that they enter and exit corners closer to how a real-world driver would, whilst carrying a more appropriate amount of speed through corner apexes.  

AI performance in Wet weather conditions has also been taken into consideration. The changes relating to acceleration in particular mean AI performance is now better aligned with how your car is expected to drive in the same track conditions. As a result, lap times for the AI in the Wet are slightly slower, differing on a track and difficulty level basis. 
[/i][/p][previewyoutube="coJjPrFS7TY;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]
We believe these refinements better balance the flow of racing between you and the AI. You may find it more difficult to dive-bomb them going into corners, or that the AI's out-of-corner acceleration isn't as strong as before. In Dry conditions, lap times for AI drivers are nearly identical to what they were pre-patch, however, these driving characteristics changes may encourage you to adjust your difficulty setting accordingly.  Please continue to share your feedback following these changes - we look forward to hearing what you think.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]Career[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Two Player Career which could cause a crash when transitioning between seasons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Peripherals (Wheels/Controllers)[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue with Trueforce not working as intended on the Logitech G923 before unpausing or using a rewind[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Audio[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Race Engineer messages could overlap when resuming from the pause menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Race Engineer messages could overlap during a session[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where subtitles were not shown for some podium commentary lines[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Graphics[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a small amount of light could be incorrectly seen within the cockpit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue which was causing some trees at Suzuka to appear incorrect[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Miscellaneous[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in Splitscreen so the position number for both players is now shown in the correct place[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a number of minor issues with the placement and appearance of numbers and sponsors in the Decal Editor[/p][/*][*][p]Various UI improvements[/p][/*][*][p]General stability improvements[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/cebadc5f07c0bbc630182c453b217fd56f21e1dd.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Check-in with our ‘Engineers’[/b][/h1][p]Whether it’s on the [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/category/f1-25-en"]EA Forums[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.reddit.com/r/F1Game/"]r/F1Game on Reddit[/url][/u], or across our [u][url="https://linktr.ee/easportsf1"]social media pages[/url][/u], thank you for making your voice heard by contributing to the F1® 25 discussion so far.

Be sure to keep an eye on the [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25---community-raised-issues-last-update-june-4/12214104"]Community-Raised Issues thread[/url][/u]. This post on the EA Forums serves as the go-to place to stay up-to-date on some of what the development team is working on in relation to bugs and issues raised by you, the community. This thread will be updated regularly between patches. To be notified of these changes, sign-in to the EA Forums and tap the bell in the top-right corner of the post.

If you would like to take the time to log a bug, please do so on our dedicated [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/category/f1-25-en/ideas/f1-25-bug-reports-en"]Technical Issues & Bug Reports[/url][/u] page on the EA Forums, where a member of our team will get back to you. You can find the best bug reporting process by [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25--how-to-report-a-bug/12211551"]clicking here[/url][/u].

We also have a number of support guides for F1® 25 including a [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25-pc-and-wheel-troubleshooting-guide/12211575"]PC Troubleshooting Guide[/url][/u] and tips for setting up F1® 25 to work in [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25---vr-and-triple-screen-setup-tips-pc-only/12266987"]Virtual Reality and Triple Screens on PC[/url][/u]. These can be found in the [u][url="https://forums.ea.com/category/f1-25-en/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en"]F1® Game Info Hub[/url][/u] on EA Forums.

To keep up-to-date on all the other F1® 25 news, be sure to follow us across social media. Links to these profiles and other useful information can be [u][url="https://linktr.ee/easportsf1"]found here[/url][/u].  

- James / CM_TGK[/p][p]Social, Community, and Creator Manager @ EA SPORTS / Codemasters[/p]

An adjustment was made to ensure that the underbody scraping is now the same between the player car and AI cars. We expect this change to allow the player car to reach an appropriate top speed, performing as expected across all circuits and weather conditions.[/i]
[/p][list][*][p]Made adjustments to the automatic gearbox in wet conditions. notes.title: F1® 25 - Community Feedback Update
notes.content:
[p]Hey racers, 
[/p][p]We hope you're enjoying your time with F1® 25 following the game’s launch at the end of May. Since then, we've seen so many of you jump into your favourite single-player modes, race online, and spend time crafting some truly impressive liveries with the new Decal Editor. We're loving what we're seeing so far, and it looks like you are too.
[/p][p]All the while, the team has been hard at work squashing bugs and investigating issues you've taken the time to report. In case you missed it, the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3059520/view/546737172113262520"]first patch[/url] (v1.03) dropped on June 9 and we have our next patch (v1.04) lined up for June 23. The full patch notes will be shared on June 20 at 3pm UTC.
[/p][p]And we're not stopping there. Between patches, you can track some of the bugs and issues being worked on in the [url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25---community-raised-issues-last-update-june-16/12214104"]Community-Raised Issues thread[/url] with several updates every week.
[/p][p]One area the team has focused a lot of attention on for F1® 25 is the single-player racing experience. It’s been great to see videos of the intense battles you’ve been having with the AI across each of the 24 circuits in the game and clearly the work the team put in is paying off. 
[/p][p]With over 100 difficulty options and each AI competitor equipped with unique driving characteristics that require split-second calculations, any adjustments to how these drivers race needs extensive testing. That said, the team is digesting all of the comments and feedback you have about your experience racing alongside computer-controlled opponents to see if and what can be done to make this even better, whilst ensuring any updates enhance the experience for the entire F1® 25 community. This may take some time but we’ll be sure to update you along the way.
[/p][p]Right now though, one thing the team have made adjustments to based on your feedback is how AI drivers perform on race starts, as they were at times a little slow getting off the line. That change will be made [b]alongside the upcoming v1.04 patch[/b], so make sure your reaction times are sharpened!
[/p][p]If you have any feedback you’d like to share on single-player racing behaviours, or anything else for that matter, videos with added context go a long way. As always, the best place for these is on the [url="https://forums.ea.com/category/f1-25-en"]EA Forums[/url], as this ensures the feedback shared will make its way back to the team.
[/p][p]Thanks so much for your continued support and feedback on F1® 25 so far. Be sure to keep it coming and stay tuned to our [url="https://linktr.ee/easportsf1"]social channels[/url] and the [url="https://forums.ea.com/blog/f1-games-game-info-hub-en/f1%C2%AE-25---community-raised-issues-last-update-june-16/12214104"]Community-Raised Issues thread[/url] for all the latest updates.
[/p][p]Happy racing!
[/p][p]- James / CM_TGK
Community and Creator Manager @ EA SPORTS / Codemasters[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: PC Features in F1 25
notes.content:
[h3]This Story is Yours. [/h3]

Leave your mark on the world of racing in F1® 25, the official video game of the 2025 FIA Formula One World Championship™.

Below, you can find the PC features you can enjoy in F1® 25. We have covered everything from the newly introduced path tracing to playing on the keyboard, steering wheel, or controller.

[b]Real Time Path Tracing:[/b]
Path tracing lets us cast light rays from every pixel in the camera view and simulate the light bouncing 3-4 times around the scene. Each bounce samples a surface, and the light moves to the next surface. This makes a cloud of colour that we can use some advanced algorithms to resolve back into pixels from the lit 3D scene. Path tracing offers the most advanced simulation of light interactions.

For example, there are hundreds of thousands of light sources in Bahrain. Simulating the type of real time shadow interaction, self-reflection, and colour bounce you get with path tracing is far ahead of older techniques.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/94ff45cda124b9d9829f5289acbd3c256306b303.png[/img]

[b]Ray Tracing:[/b]
Immerse yourself deeper into your F1® experience with Raytraced visuals available in Race using the “Ultra” graphics preset.*

[b]Virtual Reality:[/b]
Exclusive to PC. Feel the drama of the race from right inside the cockpit.

[b]Custom Graphics Settings:[/b]
We’ve added a bunch of settings so players can tweak the game to run just how they like it, whether cranking up the graphics for top performance or keeping things smooth on a portable device. Since everyone’s setup differs, we wanted to ensure something for everyone. And if you’d rather not mess with settings, no worries, we’ve got some handy presets to get you going fast.

[b]Custom Race UI:[/b]
Fully optimise your heads-up display with the most comprehensive customisation options in a racing title.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/514d9bcb3c78b57b1f39815ccd4fb2d638c456f2.png[/img]

[b]Eye Tracking Support:[/b]
Become one with your F1® Car - track your eye movements when you’re behind the wheel to improve performance.

[b]Highlights & Replays:[/b]
Export clips to video files, save full replays and even share them with friends. Supports a range of output formats including 360 video. 

[b]Custom Race Setups:[/b]
Use the Steam workshop feature to find and download balanced setups for every Grand Prix by using custom setups created by the community.

[i]*Raytraced Shadows and Reflections, Requires Raytracing graphics hardware. Path Tracing requires AMD RTX 30 series, AMD RX 7900 or Intel ARC A series or above. More powerful recent hardware will have a better experience.[/i]


[b]Ultrawide Monitor Support:[/b]
Full support on track for ultrawide monitor setups*. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/8b911d3110930b5b427c20d37c7261a0d2246683.jpg[/img]

[b]Triple Monitor Support:[/b]
Wraparound support only for multiple monitor setups*.
 
[i]*Large format display support requires sufficient VRAM. UI and Cinematics will display centered at 16:9. [/i]

[b]Additional Controller Support:[/b]
Extensive support for hand held controllers, wheels, pedals, and custom hardware including motion rigs. Out of the box mapping support, plus all controls fully customisable and remappable. 

[b]Supported Devices:[/b]
EA SPORTS F1® 25 supports a wide variety of devices for you to play on, from keyboard to steering wheel.  See https://www.ea.com/games/f1/f1-25 for more details on supported devices.


[b]Steering Wheel Controls on PC[/b]

Using a [url=https://www.logitechg.com/en-gb/products/driving/g923-trueforce-sim-racing-wheel.941-000150.html]Logitech G923 for PC[/url] as an example (assignments may vary depending on your setup and you can rebind multiple options):

notes.content:
It’s almost time to hit the grid. Here’s your one-stop-shop on all of the key information, content and advancements we’ve made to this year’s game.

[h2]Pre-Load Timings[/h2]

First-off, let’s get F1® 25 onto your PC. If you’ve pre-purchased, you can download the game to your system from [b]May 20 at 15:00 UTC[/b].


[h2]Launch Timings[/h2]

The big day is fast approaching, Iconic Edition players can hit the track from as early as May 27. Check out the timings below for both Iconic and Standard Edition.

Additionally, EA Play members can trial F1® 25 for 5 hours from May 27, and [url=https://www.ea.com/games/f1/f1-25/ea-play?isLocalized=true]EA Play Pro members will have full access to the Iconic Edition [/url]from the same date.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/c817c5cd71d5792b1b43b574b205b770eb9cfc24.png[/img]



[h3]PC Specs[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/3bf84f9ef1628db8bfc10585f1b9b3cb2cd65be1.jpg[/img]

[h2]What’s new in F1 25?[/h2]
Here is a breakdown of everything new and noteworthy that you can look forward to in F1® 25, from as early as May 27.
For further details, check out our previous articles and videos here:

[list]
[*] [url=https://www.ea.com/games/f1/f1-25/news/f1-25-career-deep-dive]My Team 2.0 & Driver Career - Deep Dive[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.ea.com/games/f1/f1-25/news/f1-25-advancements-deep-dive]Authenticity & Customisation - Deep Dive[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.ea.com/games/f1/f1-25/news/f1-25-braking-point]Braking Point 3 - The Story So Far[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.ea.com/games/f1/f1-25/news/f1-25-driver-ratings]Driver Ratings - Reveal [/url]& [url=https://www.ea.com/games/f1/ratings]Stats[/url]
[/list]

[h3]My Team 2.0:[/h3]

One of the series’ most popular game modes, My Team receives its biggest overhaul since it was introduced in F1® 2020, challenging you to call the shots as the owner of your F1® team. 

In addition to handling day-to-day running of the critical facilities that make an F1® team tick such as Engineering, Personnel and Corporate, you’ll be responsible for recruiting and managing a pair of drivers to represent your team. 

Then, during race weekends, you’ll be given the choice as to which driver you’d like to take to the track.

Check out our Deep Dive to all the details:

[previewyoutube=xDzAUYH6I7A;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]LIDAR:[/h3]

F1® 25 takes a big step forward when it comes to graphical fidelity. Not only do the tracks look better than ever, but they're much more accurate too, thanks to Light Detection and Ranging scanning, also known as LIDAR. 

Bahrain, Miami, Melbourne, Suzuka and Imola join Silverstone and have all been digitally scanned, generating millions of data points. This data, ranging from tiny asphalt surface details to the height of kerbs and distance to barriers, is used for unprecedented accuracy when recreating tracks in-game, ensuring you feel every bump and change in elevation, just like F1® drivers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/265b109e90947ae4b907db7cbeea89508ddce7b4.png[/img]

[h3]Reverse Tracks:[/h3]

In a first for the official F1® games, you can experience some of your favourite races in a unique way. 

Race around Silverstone, Zandvoort, and the Red Bull Ring in a reverse track layout. Enjoy these once-familiar circuits in Grand Prix, Time Trial, and Multiplayer, or add them to My Team and Driver Career from your second season onwards.

This isn’t a case of just turning the cars around on the starting grid. On top of computer-controlled (AI) drivers needing to be retrained, you’ll notice that every detail in a typical Grand Prix has been adapted for racing in reverse. This includes subtle changes you may not even think about such as brake boards, start-lights, off-track cameras for replays, grid boxes, and even marshals and flag wavers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/cca95c9403e3b68a443eb9badae07ee3d863d30f.png[/img]

[h3]Handling, AI & Graphics Enhancements:[/h3]

Through a combination of rigorous internal tests and feedback gathered from the EA SPORTS F1® community, F1® Sim Racing participants, and EA Creator Network members, a number of changes have been made to how cars feel in F1® 25. There’s many points to cover on this topic, [url=https://www.ea.com/games/f1/f1-25/news/f1-25-advancements-deep-dive]and we’ve done so here[/url].

Additionally, the studio has tuned AI drivers to better reflect their overtaking capabilities. 

Other adjustments have been made, such as AI now being more likely to pull off defensive manoeuvres when protecting a position. Furthermore, the AI will make better tactical decisions as to when to deploy DRS (Drag Reduction System) and ERS. 

Moving on to the visuals, we've balanced the lighting of the game to give each daylight weather scenario a more realistic look. Watch how the shadows in full sun transition and cloud cover appear more naturally or disappear completely. 

In addition, an emerging PC-exclusive innovation called Path Tracing is being introduced. 
Expanding on Ray Tracing technology and available as a new “Ultra Max” option in the graphics settings, light now follows every bounced path, including that from indirect lighting and multiple reflections. Shade, light, and colours dynamically shift as they would in real-life, whether you’re racing under the thousands of lights in Bahrain or navigating the castle section on Baku at sunset.

If you have a PC capable of experiencing it, Path Tracing is the most realistic simulation of light on track that we’ve ever delivered.

[previewyoutube=smwFJlL9wCU;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]What to Play First?[/h2]

F1® 25 is a vast game with something for everyone. Whether this is your first time on-track or you’re a veteran of the grid, here’s some suggestions on where to begin your journey:


[b]Braking Point 3 [/b]• Live out your very own blockbuster through this original story of Konnersport’s dramatic challenge for glory. This is a great starting point for new players and those looking for a narrative experience.

[b]Driver Career •[/b] Choose a real-world driver or race as your own creation across multiple seasons. Battle your rivals on and off-track to get the best seat and take the title. Add Konnersport or APXGP as an 11th team to drive for and compete against.

[b]My Team • [/b]Take charge as the owner and principal of your very own F1® team, or bring Konnersport or APXGP to the grid as the 11th team. Hire drivers, develop your car and manage your workforce in our biggest game mode yet.

[b]F1 Movie Content • [/b]Experience the cinematic event of the year ahead of its theatrical release in June. Drive as Sonny Hayes and Joshua Pearce as APXGP challenge the grid.

[b]F1® World • [/b]The hub for solo, competitive and casual play. Create your own races with Grand Prix™, set hotlaps in Time Trial, beat the best in Ranked Multiplayer and take on Invitationals with your friends to unlock rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45557445/53752d3dd4f96109aab7e4126b2ce2eced02d693.png[/img]

[h2]Pre-Purchase:[/h2]

From industry-leading graphical technologies to new ways to race some of the world’s most iconic F1® circuits, F1® 25 is set to be our most definitive F1® experience yet.

Developed by Codemasters, EA SPORTS F1® 25 launches May 30, 2025 for PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. Players who own F1® 23 or F1® 24 on PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, EA App, or Steam® can take advantage of a 15% pre-order loyalty* discount†† off the Iconic Edition.

Pre-purchase* the F1® 25 Iconic Edition to get up to 3-days early access, a number of perks linked to cover star Lewis Hamilton and Apple Original Films’ F1***, as well as a selection of instantly available 2025 season liveries for use in F1® 24 Time Trial mode**, and much more.

Pre-purchase* the F1® 25 Standard Edition, featuring cover stars Oscar Piastri, Carlos Sainz, and Oliver Bearman and get the F1® 75 Celebration Pack, F1® World “Starter Pack”, and 5,000 PitCoin.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3059520/F1_25/
